Mind Robotics: An AI robot that learns from real data at Rivian factories to automate dexterous manual tasks

Mind Robotics is an AI-native industrial robotics platform developed primarily for enterprise manufacturing, including the automotive sector, designed to automate dexterous, judgment-based factory tasks that traditional robots have struggled to perform.

Starting from an internal project at electric vehicle manufacturer Rivian (internally known as "Project Synapse"), the company has expanded its business scope to develop an integrated suite of foundation models, specialized hardware, and deployment infrastructure for factories, with a vision ranging from implementation on Rivian's production lines to expansion into other fields such as home applia

The greatest value of this platform lies in its strategic evolution from the stage of programming individual robots separately to continuously training models with actual production data, thereby supporting the coverage of dexterous tasks across the entire factory floor.

As labor shortages and reliance on manual labor become increasingly severe in manufacturing sites worldwide, Mind Robotics goes beyond being a mere automation device, with its core value proposition being the introduction of "physical intelligence" capable of adapting to real-world fluctuations into the factory.
